title: Clementi, Op. 36 No. 1, engraved by Brian D. Rude

fields.readable: false when the reader could follow no bar of the piece. The piece keeps its licence and its credits and drills nothing.
fields.bars: the bars the reader could follow, numbered as written in the source.
fields.bars[].notes[].d: the diatonic index of the note, C4 being 28, so a staff position is one subtraction.
fields.bars[].notes[].acc: the accidental to print, or null. Settled here so that no drawing code has to.
fields.read.refused: what was dropped, and how often, per piece.
